controls.label: Shape
controls.qualification: A sphere of the published radius, lit by TOI-2257; the neutral gray is a display convention, not a measured color.
controls.notes: No image or color of TOI-2257 b is published: the sphere has its measured size, and the gray marks an unresolved surface. The lighting is its own star's, at the measured orbit. The gray takes the color of toi-2257's light, as its color dataset measures it.

charts.alt: The orbits of TOI-2257's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-2257 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

TOI-2257 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (53, 74, 75) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 198485881, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 15-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
